test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_sort_decimal (id UInt64, id_hash UInt64, ts DateTime64(3), d Decimal64(4), value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_sort_decimal SELECT number % 10000 AS id, sipHash64(number % 10000) AS id_hash, toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalMillisecond(intDiv(number, 10000) * 15000 + sipHash64(number) % 1000) AS ts, toDecimal64(intDiv(number, 10000), 4) / 100 - 50 AS d, (number % 997) / 7.0 AS value FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT id, ts, value FROM jit_sort_decimal ORDER BY id, ts FORMAT Null
SELECT id_hash, ts, value FROM jit_sort_decimal ORDER BY id_hash, ts FORMAT Null
SELECT id, ts, value FROM jit_sort_decimal ORDER BY id DESC, ts DESC FORMAT Null
SELECT id, d, value FROM jit_sort_decimal ORDER BY id, d FORMAT Null
